verdict.rationale: Jan ships its own local API server at localhost:1337 that is OpenAI-compatible, with chat completions that support streaming and tool calling. It also has an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint for Anthropic SDK clients, and its docs say it connects with Claude Code, so a coding agent can use Jan as its model backend. Missing for 10: a detailed step-by-step coding-agent setup guide (Claude Code is only a one-line mention), and independent or hands-on proof that a coding agent runs well against Jan.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend

citations.quote: Supports streaming, tool calling, and multi-turn conversations
Jan automatically translates requests to the internal format, so you can use Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server
Connect Jan with Claude Code, OpenClaw, MCP servers, and more.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`. Use it as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs
